verdict.rationale: Helicone supports webhooks that fire on request-completion events and can be filtered so only requests matching ALL specified properties trigger them, plus alerts that monitor error rates/costs — both are event-triggered automations. However, this is a narrow, fixed set of trigger types (webhooks, alerts) rather than a general user-defined rules engine with configurable conditions and arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible rule-builder UI/API for custom conditions and actions beyond webhooks/alerts, and independent confirmation these automations work reliably in production.
